## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated for the changed behavior.
- [ ] Relevant CI workflows pass.
- [ ] Database migrations are reversible or have a documented recovery plan.
- [ ] Dependency input and hash-pinned lockfiles are updated together when dependencies change.
- [ ] Documentation and operational guidance are updated.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data or production dumps are included.

## Security and compatibility

- [ ] Tenant isolation and authorization are preserved.
- [ ] Authentication/session behavior and audit events are covered where relevant.
- [ ] Input limits, error handling and logging were reviewed.
- [ ] Backward compatibility and deployment impact are documented.
- [ ] Any remaining risks or intentionally deferred work are listed below.

## Remaining risks

List known limitations. Write "None identified" only after reviewing the impact; do not use this field to imply a security review or production approval.
